learningIntentions.initial:
Use case: text-localization. Asset type: revised NSPA scholarship workshop learning-intentions infographic.
Edit target: attached local reference image. Preserve its portrait 3:4 format, three numbered vertical panels, generous white space, teal #007681, slate #2E4F66, orange #FF7233, gold #FFCD34, and attractive paper-cut/frosted-glass illustration style. Keep a modest evidence magnifier in panel 1, people at an opportunity doorway in panel 2, and a smaller checklist in panel 3. Resize illustrations to prioritize readable text. Replace all main wording with the exact wording below. Remove old peripheral slogans and old checklist wording. No invented logos. Use clean, large, accurate type; no text omissions or extra slogans.
Title: Learning intentions
Subtitle: Trust, Transparency, and AI
Panel 1 heading: What am I learning today?
Panel 1 body: I am learning how AI can support scholarship teams and applicants while people protect privacy, verify evidence, and make decisions.
Panel 2 heading: Why am I learning this?
Panel 2 body: Clear review practices help applicants understand the rules and help providers explain decisions. I want to use AI responsibly and question unsupported claims.
Panel 3 heading: How will I know that I learned it?
Intro: I can:
Six checkmarked items, exactly:
Write a review prompt with role, task, context, criteria, format, and constraints.
Check completeness, draft scores, and neutral summaries against the original evidence.
Name who approves inputs, verifies outputs, and makes decisions.
Compare repeated fictional tests with independent human review.
Explain applicant AI rules, detector limits, and the provider’s own AI use.
Plan a clerical pilot with 30 / 60 / 90-day steps, an owner, and a pause condition.
Footer: NSPA 2026 · Miguel Guhlin · mguhlin.org
Keep all six success criteria readable. The panel 3 illustration may be small to leave adequate text width. No extra explanatory text inside illustrations.
